breaking.member: url() cross-origin() and referrer-policy(); <iframe> crossorigin and referrerpolicy
breaking.change: A remote url() takes only integrity(). cross-origin() and referrer-policy() are refused, as are a remote <iframe>'s crossorigin and referrerpolicy attributes: the engine fetches without cookies, credentials or a referrer of its own on both hosts, so they protected nothing. A document or style pack that names one fails to load and says why. Natively the engine no longer emulates the browser's CORS check; in a browser the engine Worker still reads another origin's image only when the server allows the game's origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).
breaking.fix: Delete cross-origin(…) and referrer-policy(…) from url() values, and crossorigin and referrerpolicy from remote <iframe>s. Keep integrity("sha384-…") where it is.
